scope: Installed Last Epoch ordinary ilvl100 Exalted prophecy rewards, conditional on generated equipment classRequirement; no idol/altar/experimental/champion rewards.

poolSelectionRules.canRollOn: contains actual EquipmentType; ordinary types never use idol subtype groups
poolSelectionRules.weighting: First matching specificRerollChances.weighting by equipmentType, otherwise weighting
poolSelectionRules.naturalT6Eligibility: Normal=0, or MaximumAffixEffectModifier=2 and actual modifier <= maximumAffixEffectModifierForT6
poolSelectionRules.doNotRemoveT6IneligibleAffixes: They remain valid T1-T5 choices and may be affected by lens upgrades/force fallback; model the native path, do not drop them from the initial pool.
poolSelectionRules.selectionOrder: Preserve the order affixes are generated; forced exalted fallback scans the original affix list, not a resampled compatible pool.
poolSelectionRules.classConditioning: These profiles condition on equipment base classRequirement, not player class. Ordinary rewards still call rollRandomlyRequiresClassCompatibility; do not mix class profiles with equal weights.

classSelector.meaning: classRequirement of the generated equipment subtype; conditional probabilities, not all rewards for a player class
